mapper.sql: external_id AS id, email, role, status, invited_at, expires_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM organization_invites
organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID}
AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'pending' AND expires_at > NOW()
AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (status = 'expired' OR (status = 'pending' AND expires_at <= NOW()))
AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'accepted'
AND (status = 'deleted' OR deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
AND FALSE
ORDER BY invited_at DESC, uuid DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_invites ( external_id, organization_uuid, email, role, status, invited_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.Email}, #{params.Role}, 'pending', #{params.InvitedAt}, #{params.ExpiresAt} ) RETURNING
